items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

ctx.x: Yeah I saw him in 1968 I think and I just — he — it was with the Mothers of Invention and I’m sure I was impressed but at the same time confused.
Yeah I don’t get it, as we were saying, but I know there must be something there because I have friends that think he’s really great. Do you know Ed Palermo?
